title: Talk of Europe - The debates of the European Parliament as Linked Open Data
contributors: S.G. Giannini (Università degli studi di Bari Aldo Moro)
Funding Agency: Clarin ERIC and Clarin-NL.
descriptions: --- Please note: this dataset is replaced by a new version. A link to the new version is provided under 'Relation'. --- The Talk of Europe (TOE) project has curated the proceedings of the European Parliament (EP) from 1999 onwards, including all available translations in other EU languages, and converted these to RDF. Moreover, the data are enriched with biographical and political information on the speakers. Since the data are available in multilingual form, this dataset lends itself to be linked with resources in other European countries, such as parliamentary records or news reports.
The research documentation is in English. Please note, the data files can not be downloaded all at once. Please contact DANS via info@dans.knaw.nl to obtain all data files at once.
